schema_notes: expected_label is the NLI-style ground truth (entailment/contradiction/neutral). The engine should mark 'entailment' cases as supported (score >= threshold) and both 'contradiction' and 'neutral' as unsupported. Contradiction cases exist to confirm P(entailment) comes out clearly low, not just under threshold; neutral cases test the harder boundary where a plausible-sounding but unstated claim should still score low.
